Name: Soul Scythe (Golden Scythe Replacement - CP)
Author: xMaa9x
Description:
I recommend using this mod with my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23442]Soul Eater Style[/url] mod (which needs [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url] to work),
so you can take your cosplay game to the next level!

[b]Current "issue":[/b]
(For some reason [b]the item name 'Golden Scythe' does not change to 'Soul Scythe'[/b], and I have no idea why.
If anyone knows why the code doesn't work, [b]please let me know[/b], so I can update it!)
